caption: Figure 1: Matching Networks architecture
description:
Description: The figure is a diagram illustrating the architecture of a Matching Network, a type of one-shot learning model. It shows the flow of data from input images through various layers and operations, including convolutional layers, a feature extractor, a distance function, and a softmax layer. The diagram includes multiple input images, each labeled with a color, and shows how these inputs are processed to produce a final output.

caption: Figure 2: Example of two 5-way problem instance on ImageNet. The images in the set S ′ contain classes never seen during training. Our model makes far less mistakes than the Inception baseline.
description:
## Figure Description
This figure is a visual representation of a 5-way problem instance on ImageNet, comparing the performance of MatchNet and Inception models. The images in set S' contain classes unseen during training. The figure shows that MatchNet makes fewer mistakes than the Inception baseline.

## Textual Content
MatchNet, Inception, S', 5-way problem instance, ImageNet, classes never seen during training, fewer mistakes, Inception baseline.
